content: Pitch Black (Pokemon TCG: Mega Evolution -- Pitch Black, set code ME05) releases worldwide 2026-07-17 (prereleases 2026-07-04 to 2026-07-12); NOT YET RELEASED as of context-gathering date 2026-07-13, per D-02 seed with best-available pre-release data and verify post-release. Booster Box (36 packs) MSRP $161.64. Booster Bundle (6 packs) MSRP $26.94. Elite Trainer Box MSRP $49.99 (both standard and Pokemon Center-exclusive variants confirmed to exist -- standard only in scope). Confirmed product lineup includes Booster Box, Booster Bundle, Build & Battle (out of scope per D-05), and ETB (both variants).
